brief:
Middle East Eye published commentary rejecting characterizations that Muslims are establishing an "Islamic Republic" in Britain, asserting instead that the country represents their home. The piece, attributed to Soumaya Ghannoushi, directly challenges what it describes as Prime Minister Netanyahu's "absurd comments" for advancing what the author calls a deeply exclusionary conception of citizenship—one in which religious visibility becomes conflated with demographic threat.

The commentary frames the broader debate as a clash between two competing visions of national belonging and identity. It argues against the narrative that Muslim presence in Britain constitutes a danger to the nation's secular character or foundational values, contending instead that Muslims are integral to British society.

title: Commentary rejects Netanyahu's 'Islamic Republic' claims about Britain
